name: Vasa Denticity Ltd
tagline: Dental-supplies e-commerce platform with high revenue growth, but a trusted tracker who built a real position has now fully exited amid supplier pushback and guidance credibility issues
business_overview: Vasa Denticity (Dentalkart) runs a dental-products e-commerce platform with 20,000+ SKUs, 30 owned brands, and 300+ domestic/international brand tie-ups, targeting India's practicing-dentist market and recently expanding into the UK.
fundamentals_narrative: Headline revenue CAGR (52%) is exceptional, but FY25 results already showed margin compression (PAT +13% vs revenue +45%, driven by a doubling of 'other expenses'), and subsequent quarters (Nov 2025, Feb 2026) were explicitly described in-thread as 'disappointing' / 'pathetic' against management's own prior guidance, which the community flagged as a repeated overpromising pattern.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 of 102 posts (May 2025-Jun 2026, no escalation needed). Sentiment arc: constructive through mid-2025 on UK expansion (Dentalkart Distribution UK Ltd) and moat-building discussion, but multiple headwinds accumulated from late 2025: several dental-product brands issued notices distancing themselves from or restricting sales via Dentalkart (Jan 2026, reason unresolved in-thread but a real business/authorization risk), a CFO resignation (Mar 2026, framed as unrelated but coinciding with weak results), and a planned IDS Denmed acquisition was withdrawn (May 2026).
community_signal: vikasbargale (trusted, elevated) was the single most engaged tracker, building a real disclosed position (5% of portfolio at one point, Jan 2026) through 2025, but by Jun 2026 explicitly stated: 'I have totally exited my position' -- a clear supersede of his own earlier bullish/building-position calls, driven by repeated guidance misses and unresolved supplier-notice concerns. Marathondreams (trusted, elevated) separately cautioned the thread (Jun 2026) against following well-known investors' stakes as a reason to invest, given their different objectives/sizing.

trusted_signals.note: Building a disclosed position through 2025 (posts #66-#82), reaching 5% of portfolio by Jan 2026 ('Invested and Biased. 5% of portfolio').
post #101: 'I have totally exited my position' -- explicit exit after repeated disappointing results and supplier-notice concerns, superseding his own earlier building-position calls.

bull_case: Exceptional headline revenue CAGR (52%) against a near-zero industry median -- real category-leadership growth
Genuine UK market expansion via a new distribution subsidiary
bear_case: A trusted user who built a real, disclosed 5% position has now fully exited, citing repeated results disappointments relative to management's own guidance
Multiple dental-product brands issuing notices distancing themselves from Dentalkart (Jan 2026) is an unresolved, real business/authorization risk, not just noise
CFO resignation and a withdrawn acquisition (IDS Denmed) both landed within the same negative-news window
Margin compression already visible in FY25 (other expenses doubled) even before the FY26 guidance misses
verdict_headline: Real top-line growth undercut by a trusted tracker's full exit, supplier pushback, and a repeated pattern of management overpromising
verdict_reasoning: The supersede signal here is the deciding factor: a trusted user who built and disclosed a real 5% position has fully exited, specifically citing the same guidance-credibility and supplier-notice issues visible in-thread

No formal AVOID-tier red flag, but the combination of unresolved supplier notices, a CFO departure, and a withdrawn acquisition is enough negative-signal density to filter this out despite the headline growth rate
Worth a revisit only if the supplier-notice issue is resolved and guidance credibility is rebuilt over a couple of clean quarters

four_box.note: A trusted user fully exited citing guidance-credibility and unresolved supplier-notice issues plus a CFO departure and withdrawn acquisition per verdict - negative-signal density across the board despite headline growth.
